addPerson.title: Add person
addPerson.introMember: They stay the same person in the directory; the login is linked to their entry.
addPerson.intro: Everyone goes in the directory, so escalation can route a report above the person it names. Only people who need to sign in get a login.
addPerson.memberNoEmail: Their directory entry has no email, and a login needs one.
addPerson.managerAuto: Work it out from the hierarchy
addPerson.managerHelp: Leave blank and we'll work it out from the hierarchy where there's only one possible answer.
addPerson.employeeIdHint: optional — made from the name if blank
addPerson.createLoginHelp: Leave off for people who only need to be in the directory.
addPerson.usernameWarning: — capitals and symbols are kept exactly and must be typed the same at sign-in. Set a plain lowercase username to avoid that.
addPerson.entityRoleRefused: An entity admin can’t be added here. Add the person with another role, then use Change role to make them an entity admin and pick their entity.

dirLink.title: Directory entry for {{name}}
dirLink.intro: The directory entry decides which reports this person can see — their own team's, through the reporting tree. Their role decides what they can do with them.
dirLink.levelHelp: Comes from {{name}}'s role. To move them, change their role; to move everyone in a role, change the role's level in Roles & Permissions.
dirLink.unlinkedWarning: Unlinked, anyone allowed to see their team's reports sees only their own cases instead.

undelivered.resendBody: A new temporary password is set and emailed to {{email}}. They must replace it when they sign in.
undelivered.policy: Use 8+ characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.
undelivered.testDomain: This address is at a reserved test domain, so the email can't arrive here either.
undelivered.body: Their welcome email wasn’t delivered, so they can’t sign in. Resend to set a new password and email it.

row.unknown_manager: Their manager needs an Employee ID on another row.

row.role_has_no_level: The role exists but has no level, so the person can’t be placed. Give it one in Roles & Permissions.

row.unknown_sign_in_method: Use Password, Google or Microsoft — or leave it blank for Password.
row.ambiguous_sign_in_method: “SSO” could be Google or Microsoft. Say which.
row.sign_in_method_without_login: This row creates no login, so a sign-in method doesn’t apply. Clear it, or set Create Login.
row.undeliverable_domain: Fine for a test import; a real person needs a real address.

inferred.body: These rows named no manager, and exactly one person sat one level above them in the same department. Reporting lines decide who hears about an allegation, so check they're right.

importUsers.warnings_other: {{count}} things to check — these won't stop the import
importUsers.title: Import people
importUsers.doneHelp: New password accounts start on a temporary password and must set their own when they first sign in. Google and Microsoft accounts have no password; they sign in with that account.
importUsers.step1: 1. Fill in the template. It comes with a working example — read it before replacing it. The template changed: download a fresh copy rather than reusing an old one. The Role column now places each person (there's no level column), and Sign-in Method chooses Password, Google or Microsoft.
importUsers.step2: 2. Upload it. It's checked first; nothing is created until every row is valid.
importUsers.fix: Fix these in the file and upload it again — nothing was imported.
